Discharge Summary

Admitted 2034-01-25; CAR-T cell infusion 2034-01-26; discharged 2034-02-06.

Course: grade 2 cytokine release syndrome on Day +2, treated with fluids and one dose of tocilizumab. ICANS from Day +4, including a single self-limited generalized seizure on 2034-01-31; treated with dexamethasone, tapered over six days, and levetiracetam at an increased dose. No further seizures.

Discharge ICE on 2034-02-06 at 09:30: 10/10.

Follow-up: cellular therapy clinic in one week; neurology clinic in one month.
